notes: Fluid Pace: remaining-oz continuous rebalance over true remaining minutes of first-fluid→end-time window
Logging a drink no longer creates instantaneous ahead/behind spikes (consumption-duration ramp 15–45 min)
Reaching daily fluid target immediately sets _cbFluidDayComplete and cancels Worker + local + scheduled fluid reminders for the rest of the day

Local multi-channel timer (AudioContext chime + vibrate + SW showNotification + in-app alert) arms for pace next-drink so alerts remain audible/visible even when the tab is on-screen immediately before lock
whatsNew: Mathematically correct next-drink time from remaining volume / remaining window
Atomic cancellation of all fluid reminders once daily target is met
More reliable fluid notifications via local timer + multi-channel broadcast
fixes: Pace engine treated each log as zero-duration consumption, producing artificial ahead spikes and wrong next-drink times
Reminders continued after dailyFluid >= target because only end-time set _cbFluidDayComplete
Pace-derived reminders relied solely on Cloudflare Worker; local path was missing so alerts could be missed near screen lock
